summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc., a China-based foreign private issuer formerly Chijet Motor, filed a 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering priced September 18, 2026. It sold 23,809,530 Class A ordinary shares plus Series A and Series B warrants at US$0.21 per unit, raising roughly US$5.0 million gross. Series A warrants strike US$0.44 for five years; Series B strike US$0.21 for 30 days. Proceeds fund working capital, possible digital-asset treasury operations, and D&O insurance. A 30-day standstill restricts further issuance. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and reset dilution.
